features.name: Single pane of glass
features.description: One web console at localhost:8600 covering every QI project — health, tasks, services, usage, docs, agents.

features.name: Mission Control board
features.description: Live monitoring view of the whole ecosystem — per-project phase, status, and last activity at a glance.
features.notes: Renamed from the old 'Hive' page; route /mission-control.

features.name: Ecosystem health check
features.description: Registry-driven liveness probe of every project: service state, port, git, doc freshness.
features.notes: 30s TTL cache so page loads stay fast.

features.name: Kanban task board
features.description: Cross-project task board with drag-and-drop between columns and full create/edit/delete.

features.name: Project Status pages
features.description: Maia-style 7-tab Status page per project — including this one — driven by each project's INTRO folder.

features.name: QI Launchpad / Panel
features.description: Role-labelled tiles linking to every app's local and public (tunnel) URL; tunnel-aware.

features.name: Durable ecosystem memory
features.description: Every decision, feature, session, and project-state change is recorded across all 24 projects and never lost between sessions.

features.name: Semantic search
features.description: Natural-language search across decisions, features, sessions, and documentation.
features.notes: ChromaDB; embeddings from local Ollama nomic-embed-text.

features.name: Documentation Brain
features.description: Ecosystem-wide doc index with full-text search, a TheBrain-style Plex graph, and split-view reader.

features.name: Project context recall
features.description: On session start an agent gets the project's current state, recent decisions, and pending features in a token budget.

features.name: Cross-project feature propagation
features.description: A pattern built in one project is evaluated for relevance to every other project and surfaced for adopt/adapt/skip.
features.notes: Engine + 44 evaluations exist; propagation run on demand.

features.name: Unified activity headlines
features.description: Twitter-style chronological feed merging sessions, decisions, features, dispatches, compliance, and state changes.

features.name: Specialist sub-agent team
features.description: Eight role-specialised agents (architect, builder, inspector, ops, scout, scribe, tester, librarian) the main thread dispatches work to.
features.notes: Defined as Claude Code sub-agents; routed per DISPATCH_PROTOCOL.md.

features.name: Dispatch Protocol
features.description: A standing operating discipline mapping each task type to the right agent and model, with design->build->inspect->scribe workflows.
features.notes: Keeps Opus reasoning, Sonnet building, Haiku on triage/docs.

features.name: CoWork dispatch channel
features.description: Bi-directional task/proposal board where CoWork and agents post work and Renne (or Claude) approves, declines, or discusses.
features.notes: Inspector findings kept off the human queue; idempotent.

features.name: Auto-apply pipeline
features.description: Approved dispatches flow to a builder runner that prepares the change for review.

features.name: Agent growth loop
features.description: Agents log what worked and what to improve after each task, building a profile over time.
features.notes: Tables + endpoints live; agent_growth_log not yet populated.

features.name: War Room
features.description: A shared multi-agent text channel where Renne, Claude, CoWork, and hive agents talk in one thread.

features.name: The Six Laws
features.description: An architectural constitution every QI project must honor — registry truth, the module contract, graceful degradation, contract-first APIs, current registry, owner override.

features.name: Compliance enforcement
features.description: The Inspector continuously audits every project against QI standards, auto-fixes safe issues, and files dispatches for the rest.
features.notes: Runs every 4h + nightly deep; 46k+ compliance-log rows.

features.name: One-command new project
features.description: Scaffolds a fully compliant project — registry entry, folders, CLAUDE.md, /health skeleton — in a single command.

features.name: Compliance validator
features.description: On-demand checker that confirms a project meets the registry, port-block, naming, and endpoint rules.

features.name: Compliance dashboard
features.description: A page summarising pass/fail/warn status across the ecosystem with a manual rescan button.

features.name: Autonomous service control
features.description: Any Claude session can restart, stop, or start any QI service without a UAC prompt blocking the loop.

features.name: Elevation broker
features.description: A LocalSystem daemon that runs only whitelisted admin commands dropped as JSON, solving UAC-in-the-loop.

features.name: Service & tunnel registry
features.description: Single source of truth for every QI_ Windows service plus a symptom->log lookup table.

features.name: Static public tunnels
features.description: Each public app has a permanent subdomain on quiddityinnovations.com instead of a URL that changes every restart.

features.name: LLM usage & cost tracking
features.description: Per-day, per-project, per-model Claude Code cost and token breakdowns, including savings from local-LLM routing.
features.notes: usage_stats.py parses ~/.claude JSONL; no API key.

features.name: Live runtime config
features.description: Change log levels, theme, and elevation profiles from the dashboard without restarting services.
